prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Wide 16:9 hand-painted high quality 2D game background for the final BEYOND CANON cosmic disco realm in Emerald Arcade's PepeCoin runner. No characters, text, UI, borders, roads or foreground terrain. Surreal dark interstellar space beyond the galaxy: enormous fractured antique-gold orbital rings bending around a luminous jade singularity in upper center-right, impossible floating obsidian crystal monoliths with thin gold seams, emerald-purple nebula ribbons dissolving into deep navy infinity, tiny gold dust stars and distant jade moons. Premium arcade fantasy, rich depth, sharp elegant detail and readable cosmic silhouettes. Dramatic but controlled lighting; jade singularity must have luminous green center rather than blinding white. Upper half carries scenery, LOWER HALF stays dark quiet indigo with subtle atmospheric wisps for readable green collectibles and purple spike hazards. Side-view gameplay backdrop, not perspective racing track. Distinctly more otherworldly than an ordinary galaxy, cohesive emerald/gold/violet palette, no busy rainbow clutter or strobe-like effects. Opaque full bleed scene.
